Additional Sources: `11-Agentic-Mission-Editor.md`, `17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md`, `27-Scenario-Library-Campaigns.md`

---


Linear status (refreshed 2026-10-06): DRG-208 Done · DRG-330 Done · DRG-332 Done · DRG-335 Done · DRG-334 Done (ADR-017 Accepted) · DRG-333 Done: H4 scope boundary landed via [PR #693](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/693), squash `434b3cf6` (docs-only) · DRG-345 Backlog: draft [PR #698](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698) is open, but implementation hasn't started (CMANO owns the WIP drain).

October 1 public review links: [Planning reconciliation — draft PR #690](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/690) and [Decision and horizon reviews — draft PR #691](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/691). The intake content below records the September 30 snapshot; consult the linked reviews for the current proposed changes. Repository review and owner acceptance remain pending.

Planning updates authorized 2026-09-30. The three existing documentation lanes DRG-330/332/335 were In Progress at this snapshot (now Done; see the status line above). Adopt H4 bounded existing-map authoring and capability disclosure, H5 local presentation content pilot, H6 same-build/catalog save/resume first with multiplayer separate and later. New children DRG-345–349 are Backlog behind existing scope/ADR gates. This authorizes artifact updates and planning direction; ADR acceptance, code dispatch and owner Play Mode signoff remain separate. Stage stays Release.


- Status: Draft
- Owner: drg amtd
- Related Linear Milestone: cmano-clone H4 bounded Scenario Editor GUI / H5 local presentation content pilot / H6 save-resume first (planning authorized; implementation gated). Delivery project: [Aegis Horizons H4–H6](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/project/aegis-horizons-h4-h6-fd13e33bf322)
- Last updated: 2026-09-30
- Sources: `production/agentic/linear-parallel-dispatch-playbook.md` §14 · `production/agentic/agentic-workflow-sprint-series-2026-08-09.md` §1.4 · `docs/reports/future-sprint-roadmap-07142026.md`

## 1. Overview

On 2026-09-27 the owner asked to bring H4–H6 into scope as soon as possible. Each horizon has a roadmap entry gate that is still closed. This page records what each horizon means, what is already on `main`, what blocks a start, and the decisions only the owner can make.




Horizon


Definition

## 2. Player Fantasy

- H4: the theater designer lives on the map, placing forces, drawing zones and attaching missions, and the tool never silently ships a broken scenario (`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-08-scenario-editor-phase2-design.md` §5).
- H5: richer theaters and art load quickly without bloating the build or breaking determinism.
- H6: a long campaign session can be stopped and resumed exactly. Multiplayer, if chosen, lets commanders face each other on the same deterministic picture.

## 3. Detailed Rules — current repo state

### H4 — Scenario Editor Phase 2 GUI

- The headless core is shipped: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/Scenario/Authoring/` (`ScenarioAuthoringSession`, `ScenarioEditCommandBus`, `ScenarioDocumentEditor`, `ScenarioUndoStackStore`, `MissionBoardQuery`, `EventStaticAnalyzer`).
- Headless presenters are ready to bind: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Authoring/` (`EditModeController`, `MapAuthoringSurface`, `LiveFindingsPresenter`, `MissionBoardPresenter`, `EventGraphPresenter`).
- Unity hosts exist: `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/ScenarioMapAuthoringWindow.cs` and `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/ScenarioEditorShellHost.cs` (undo/redo buttons, dirty label, Mission Board slot).
- The only GUI scope boundary is P2.1 (`production/scenario-editor-phase2-1-scope-boundary-2026-07-08.md`). Editor-host manual smoke steps 2–6 are still open (`production/qa/scenario-editor-p2-1-editor-host-checklist.md`).
- ADR-017 (editor topology) is Proposed, with a target decision date of 2026-10-01.
- 21 UX findings are parked in the Mission Editor — UX/UI Review (2026-07-26). Linear DRG-57 was canceled with its five scope questions unanswered.
- Blocking: no product prioritization, no Phase 2 GUI scope boundary, and WYSIWYG platform editor in/out undecided.

### H5 — Content Pipeline / Addressables

- `com.unity.addressables` 2.9.1 in `unity/ProjectAegis/Packages/manifest.json`. There is one group with one key, `Map/App6FrameAtlas` (`unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json`, `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs`, headless `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs`). It is consumed by `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` with a Unicode fallback (S27-07).
- The roadmap says "Addressables / remote content design undesigned". There is no content-pipeline ADR (ADR-001…026 on main; ADR-027 Unity-MCP is in open PR #679).
- `.claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md` still says Addressables 2.3.16, which has drifted from 2.9.1.
- Blocking: the ADR does not exist, and the bulk scope (which content classes, local vs remote) is undefined.

### H6 — Save-Load / Multiplayer

- There is no game-state save/load. `SimulationSession` (`src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/SimulationSession.cs`) has Pause, Resume, `SetTimeAccelerationFactor` and Tick, but no save or restore. `ReplayCheckpointStore` records only `simTick`, `worldHash`, `logFingerprint` and `lastSequenceId`, which is verification data, not restorable state.
- The GDD already describes the target: `design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md` edge case "Save/load restores simTick, scenarioSeed, RNG stream counters (checkpoint + log tail)". The determinism contract is in `docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md`.
- Multiplayer is out of v1: `design/gdd/game-concept.md`, `production/stage.txt`, `production/release/launch/faq-draft.md`. `MultiplayerManager.asset` is only the Unity default.
- ZERO-touch wording: `AGENTS.md` "DelegationBridge.cs — Zero-touch through Release v1 — no hotpath changes". `production/agentic/local-cloud-agent-routing.md` "Zero-touch: DelegationBridge hotpath / SimulationSession unless product waiver".
- Blocking: no product confirmation (save-load only vs multiplayer), no ADR, and no waiver decision.

### Standing rules (unchanged)

The suite floor follows `production/test-floor.json` (≥1638, 0 failed). Also: ReplayGolden 6/6 · Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` · PlayModeSmoke ≥20/20 · DelegationBridge ZERO hotpath · CatalogWriteGate extend-only · presentation wall ADR-010 / 007 / 001 · Stage Release.

## 4. Formulas

None defined in the current implementation.

## 5. Edge Cases — risks and hard-no exposure

### Top risks

- H6 vs the DelegationBridge hotpath hard-no. Multiplayer order injection goes through `DelegationBridge.TryEnqueueHumanOrder` / `TryIssuePlayerCommand`, and the tick is `DelegationBridge.Tick(ISimWorldSnapshot, IOrderSink)`. A full state snapshot would have to reach inside `SimulationSession` (a frozen hub). Only a replay-to-tick save driven through existing public APIs has a chance of being zero-touch. DRG-330 checks that.
- H6 vs deterministic replay. Any change to order-log or checkpoint schema (ADR-003) or to tick order can move the Baltic hash. Re-blessing ReplayGolden silently is forbidden; a re-bless needs its own ADR.
- H5 vs the presentation wall. Addressables APIs must stay in Unity presentation assemblies. `ProjectAegis.Sim`, `ProjectAegis.Data` and `ProjectAegis.Delegation` keep headless resolvers only. Sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must not load through Addressables, or the hash can drift.
- H5 vs map hosts. The only Addressables consumer is `MapPlaceholderPanelHost`, and globe tiles live behind `GlobeMapProductHost`. Bulk loading needs a new loader seam, not growth in those hosts.
- H4 vs CatalogWriteGate. Folding the WYSIWYG platform editor into H4 collides with ADR-011 (Excel-primary) and the extend-only gate.
- Tracker drift resolved for planning. cmano-clone H4–H6 milestones now describe the September30 planning direction and retain implementation gates. Delivery state must remain evidence-based.

### Hard-no matrix




Hard-no area


H4

## 2. Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07)

Present: `Sim/Engage` (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), `Sim/Sensors` (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, `ScenarioJamResolver`, datalink picture merger), `Sim/Logistics` (air/boat ops FSMs, `FuelLedger`, `ScenarioSeaState`), `Delegation/Comms` (`CommsState`, `CommsOrderDelay`, track staleness, spoof timeline), `Delegation/EmconPosture`, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349).

Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain.

## 3. New requirements

Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes.

### ENV — Environment

- ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering.
- ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick.
- ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend `ScenarioSeaState` so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state.

### ASW — Undersea warfare

- ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency.
- ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges.
- ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses `MagazineLedger`; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture.
- ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through `IEngagementResolver`; abort codes are added to `EngagementAbortReasonCodes`.
- ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty.

### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures

- EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in `ScenarioJamResolver`. AC: table-driven tests.
- EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause.
- EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation.
- EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source.

### C3 — Communications authority

- C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote `Delegation/Comms` state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an `OffGrid` reason; the UI shows the last-reported position.
- C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log.
- C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test.
- C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed `CommsOrderDelay`. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed.

### DMG — Damage & attrition

- DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into `CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate`.
- DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable.

### HUM — Crew / human factors

- HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute.
- HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests.

### OPS — Operational layer

- OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step.
- OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI.
- OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade.
- OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on `DetectionWorldHash`. Dependency: DRG-325/329.

## 4. Suggested sequencing

1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks).
2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first).
3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01.
4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03.
5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6.

pages.content:
> ✅ v1 thresholds approved 2026-10-15 (drg delegated approval to Projects Manager); other rubrics still draft. Inputs merged from Jev router, CMANO, SliceA and SliceB.

> 📌 Scope decision 2026-10-16 (drg, by voice): rubrics apply to new work AND the existing Backlog, not only new work. Jev's one-time Backlog audit idea is superseded: existing Backlog items are to be brought up to the DoR/RQI rubrics.

> 📌 Size decision 2026-10-16 (drg, by voice; corrected same day): the \~400 changed-line PR size is guidance, not a hard rule.

> 📌 Blocker waiver policy, updated Nov 20, 2026, 3:41 PM CT (Q3 A, approved by drg): only drg waives a DoR blocker. Decision may recommend. The Oct 16 rule that CMANO may waive a blocker on its own and tell drg afterward is withdrawn. If drg waives, log the reason in the Note of that Notion task, starting the Note line with 'WAIVER:' plus date, blocker, and reason.

# Section 1: Definition of Done

## Hard gates (all must be YES; no partial credit)

- H1. PR merged to main; required checks green on the merged tip, including inspect.
- H2. Linear is Done. Notion goes to Done only after Linear is Done (never the reverse).
- H3. No hard-no file touched: MapPlaceholderPanelHost, GlobeMapProductHost, DelegationBridge tick/hotpath, CatalogWriteGate, SimulationSession, CMD-31/32/34, S122/Launch, ReplayGolden re-bless. Exception only if the owner approved in chat and the PR links it; exceptions are owner-named GOs within approved lines.
- H4. Replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged (ReplayGoldenSuiteTests 6/6), or the change is explained and owner-approved. No silent re-bless.
- H5. AC tests exist and pass (named test filters plus pass counts), including a source-fence test where the story crosses the presentation wall (no UnityEngine, MonoBehaviour, ApplyOrder, DecisionLog write, SimulationSession, DelegationBridge refs).
- H6. Play Mode or visible behavior needs the owner's own Editor walk and explicit acceptance. Agent or MCP evidence never counts. Agents never start Play Mode.
- H7. Back-links both ways: the Linear issue links the PR and the Notion row; the Notion row links Linear and the PR.
- H8. Diff stays inside the reserved Surface. Any widen needs the owner's OK recorded in the PR body and in Linear before the edit.

### Added by CMANO (historical; CMANO retired, owner now per routing table)

- No `hold:owner-go` label and no AGENT-STOP / `stop:agents`.
- Build has 0 warnings.
- Tests, Play Mode smoke harness, oracle, qa-gauntlet, Buildkite and ReSharper inspect (new findings: 0) pass on the merged head.
- All Codex/Copilot review threads resolved.
- Launch/S122 stay a separate owner GO.

### Added by SliceA

- PR body has the PR-finish checklist verdict, a `Closes DRG-n` line, and exactly one of "Unity MCP: unavailable, headless only" or the MCP evidence.
- If the public package surface grew, the PR says to refresh plugin DLLs (`tools/copy-delegation-assemblies.ps1`).
- `jb inspectcode` run before opening the PR, including test files.
- Headless projections read existing snapshots only.

### Added by SliceB

- Contract-only reads: combat text comes only from the CombatEvent contract, enforced by a guard test.
- Production path: the projection has a real caller, not only a harness.
- Existing host contract test assertions intact, or changes named in the PR.
- Per-refresh / per-tick changes state the rebuild cost, with a cache plus invalidation test or a justification.

## Scored criteria (0 = missing, 1 = partial, 2 = complete; max 12)

- S1. Review threads resolved, or deferred to a Linear ticket (reply says "deferred, not fixed" plus link).
- S2. Follow-ups ticketed with owner and Surface.
- S3. Docs/ADR status accurate (a Proposed ADR is not described as accepted).
- S4. Linear evidence comment: PR, tip commit, test counts, replay hash, gate results.
- S5. Scope honesty in the PR body; no claim exceeds what is built.
- S6. Test quality: drives production composition, not a fixture rebuild; review edge cases covered.

Pass rule (approved): all hard gates YES and score >= 9 of 12.

## Owner decisions (approved 2026-10-15)

- (1) Pass line stays at 9 of 12 plus every hard gate yes.
- (2) H6 Play Mode sign-off = drg's own written "I walked it" (or equivalent explicit acceptance) in chat, and the story's agent then records a Linear comment quoting it with date. An agent's or teammate's relay of "owner OK" without drg's own words does not count.
- (3) Docs-only and tooling-only stories: H5 is "tests or a verification script"; H6 applies only if the AC names Play Mode.

## Has bitten us before

- PR without a `Closes DRG` line left Linear stale (#710).
- A relayed "owner OK" from a teammate is not approval.
- Agent cap of 4 exceeded via stale WIP counts.
- A "new files only" stamp grew an edit to an existing file (#722).
- A stamp covered the dirty-check but not the host to wire it (DRG-403).
- Merged on green while review threads were open.
- A fixture fingerprint was confused with the real replay hash.
- ReSharper findings found only in CI.
- A harness passing an Empty frame (DRG-369) looks wired but is not.
- Layout changes headless tests cannot see need a named DRG-208 Play Mode walk item.
- A fix-only agent finished before the follow-up; record agent ID and branch in Linear.

## Tooling and evidence stories (SliceC)

### Hard gates (all must be YES)

- The story names the exact `main` SHA it was verified at.
- Any GitNexus result used as proof is cross-checked with `rg`, and misses are recorded as gaps.
- A tooling PR touches no product C# or Unity files and commits no generated files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/skills/gitnexus-*`, `.gitnexus/`).
- Every gap found is filed as a Backlog item linked to the parent story, and the parent is not closed on a known-bad result.
- The code map is confirmed healthy before it is relied on: zero garbage IDs, and node and edge counts match between the metadata and the graph.

### Has bitten us before

- A GitNexus MCP process held the index DB open during a rebuild and corrupted the graph (DRG-323). Stop it before any reindex.
- GitNexus misses overloaded static calls and `AddComponent` references (DRG-324), so zero callers does not mean unused.
- `analyze` rewrites `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` and adds skill folders unless run with `--skip-agents-md --skip-skills`.

# Cloud-agent launch and handoff (CMANO, merged) (historical; CMANO retired, owner now per routing table)

## Hard gates (all must be YES)

- Probe the Unity MCP before launch; the PR says "Unity MCP: unavailable, headless only" when it is down.
- The prompt requires `jb inspectcode` on every changed file, including tests, before opening the PR.
- Check GitNexus index health before relying on it for the Surface; if unhealthy or stale, do not launch and do not invent a Surface. `rg` may explain the block or serve local investigation, not dispatch.
- A fix goes to the same agent and branch as a follow-up, with `main` merged first. If the agent will not accept one, start a fix-only agent on the same branch pushing to the same PR, with no new PR. Record the agent ID and branch in Linear.
- Every fix-only prompt says "no baseline, suppression or ReSharper-disable edits".
- If a different agent launched the work, the new owner confirms agent ID, branch and PR in Linear before any follow-up.

## Scored criteria

- The launch prompt pins the base commit SHA and lists the exact test filters.

## Rule

- Only drg stamps a new Surface or authorizes a Surface widen. Decision may recommend. Specialists send drg (via Decision) the exact files and lines they need.

# Section 2: Proposed additional rubrics (outline only — to be drafted)

## (a) Definition of Ready for a requirement/story — to be drafted

Proposed owner: Decision (stamps and waivers remain drg-only)

- Problem statement and evidence
- Testable acceptance criteria
- Surface stamped
- Hold labels checked
- Dependencies identified
- Bounded forks routed via Decision

## (b) Requirement quality / backlog intake — to be drafted

Proposed owner: Projects Manager

- No duplicates
- Source cited
- Related issues linked
- No Surface until drg stamps it
- Clear title and single outcome

## (c) Linear, Notion and GitHub sync hygiene (owners: CI config + Projects Manager)

Ownership: CI config runs the Linear side (tracker honesty). Projects Manager owns same-day Notion drift checks (can become a routine).

### Hard gates (all must be YES)

- Linear is updated first, then Notion, with links both ways.
- A story moves to Done in Linear only after its PR has merged to `main`; never based on a draft or open PR. The story carries the merge SHA and PR link.
- Every merged PR has a `Closes DRG-n` line, or CI config comments the PR and SHA on the story within one waterline refresh.
- The waterline on both Linear projects (cmano-clone and Combat Interaction UX) names the current `main` SHA. A refresh adds a new section, renames the old one to Prior, posts a status update and adds a recap comment on DRG-210 (which stays Done).
- A Linear status change is NEEDS\_OWNER. Nothing merges on a DoD PASS alone; only drg merges, by PR number, unless a written policy is in routing table §3 notes.
- New requirements go in as Backlog with no `Surface:` line; only drg stamps Surfaces.
- Every Notion Project and Task row has a page icon, and Blocked is a Status value, not free text.
- A closed or superseded PR stays closed unless drg names it.

### Scored criteria (0 = missing, 1 = partial, 2 = complete)

- Waterline matches `main` within one refresh.
- Each merged story has a PR and SHA comment.
- Notion rows match Linear status.
- Follow-up gaps are filed as Backlog items linked to the parent story.
- Summary line and status update agree.
- Review findings point to a file, a symbol and the evidence used.

### Has bitten us before

- #710 left stale without a `Closes` line.
- Review page went stale within hours as PRs landed (DRG-249, DRG-256, DRG-350).
- Stories look done in Linear while only a harness exists.
- Code map stale or corrupted, so findings need an `rg` cross-check and the `main` SHA they were verified at.
- Dependabot #714 merged while PRs were on hold (the user had approved it).
- Notion rows missing for some Linear stories (DRG-242).

## (d) Cloud-agent launch / handoff — to be drafted

Proposed owner: Decision + specialists (Surface stamps remain drg-only)

- GitNexus blast radius run
- File-disjoint Surfaces
- WIP cap of 4 respected
- Unity MCP probe line stated
- Agent ID and branch recorded in Linear

## (e) Play Mode human-walk evidence — to be drafted

Proposed owner: PlayMode + owner

- Checklist from DRG-208
- Screenshots attached
- Owner sign-off form
- Named walk item for each layout change
- No agent or MCP evidence counted

pages.title: Command experience — delivery plan and acceptance package (2026-10-30)
pages.content:
Status: Implementation plan; runtime delivery blocked by unavailable development tooling. User authorized proceeding with the recommendations in this conversation. This is not product acceptance or a waiver of frozen runtime boundaries.
Review date: 
Source baseline: [main 570a7f84](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51).
Delivery system: Linear; existing story ownership and completed work are retained.

## Outcome and scope

A player can notice a consequential event during accelerated play, inspect the evidence and doctrine behind a blocked action, take or return control, and understand what is known when communications degrade. One integrated scenario demonstrates the complete workflow. The same-build save/resume contract proceeds as a separate workstream.

Requirements: Combat Interaction UX — Proposed Requirements and Vertical Slice and Slice G - Unity UX/UI Rebaseline and Acceptance. Later mechanics derive from Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07.

## Source findings that change implementation scope

1. Basic doctrine provenance already exists in [DoctrineInheritanceProjection.cs](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/DoctrineInheritanceProjection.cs). It returns a single source label, effective ROE/max-salvo labels, EMCON and an override marker. Extend this implementation; do not create a competing projection.
2. [ScenarioPolicyProfile.ResolveUnitPolicy](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Scenario/ScenarioPolicyProfile.cs) resolves unit override, then mission, then friendly/opposing default. This read does not establish a complete per-field Side/Mission/Group/Unit cascade. Unsupported source levels must not be fabricated.
3. [ContactProvenanceState](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/ContactProvenance.cs) contains identification confidence, freshness, age, source and comms-quality flags. It contains no downrange/cross-range uncertainty or weapon-tolerance dimensions. DRG-411 first needs source-contract verification; identity confidence is not positional uncertainty.
4. [MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/MessageLogBridge.cs) uses the player-info-filtered view. New live notifications must consume the same permitted information; a hidden event must not leak through a balloon, sound, counter or pause.
5. The source tree already contains AttentionAssignmentForecastProjection and tests. The proposed attention-management enhancement is a reuse/UX-verification task, not evidence that a forecast subsystem is absent.
6. ADR-029 is Accepted. Its historical “Proposed” paragraphs and unmarked decision checkboxes need documentary reconciliation; the accepted header and explicit owner decisions govern H6 direction.

## Delivery sequence and traceability

| Order | Existing item | Deliverable | Exit evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [DRG-408](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-408), [DRG-398](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-398), [DRG-269](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-269) | Shared notification/attention policy and time-command integration; approval-specific countdown is layered onto it | Category mapping, duplicate-event handling, fog filtering, replay read-only behavior, deterministic safe-stop tests |
| 2 | [DRG-247](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-247) | Take/return control and pause/resume-agent workflow | Exactly one active controller; preserved tasking; group detach/rejoin; repeat-command behavior; replay refusal |
| 3 | [DRG-409](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-409) | Extend existing doctrine provenance; command-based reset where a supported command exists | Source/effective value agree with policy resolver; unavailable source levels explicit; reset recorded and replayable |
| 4 | [DRG-271](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-271), [DRG-411](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-411) | Stale/datalink/queued-order badges; separately gated positional-uncertainty details | Unknown differs from zero; age uses simulation time; stale selection cannot borrow another shooter/contact's facts |
| 5 | [DRG-235](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-235) | Integrated degraded-comms scenario and owner-walk evidence | Live source → projection → visible UI → command → outcome, with keyboard/pointer evidence |
| Alongside | [DRG-348](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348) → [DRG-349](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-349) | Save/resume contract, then implementation and differential proof | Whole candidate-world restore; journal completeness; uninterrupted/resumed equality; non-mutating failure |

DRG-408 owns shared category policy; DRG-398 owns accelerated-time safe-stop integration/proof; DRG-269 owns pending-approval/DLZ behavior. This avoids three independent alert systems. No new epic duplicates Slice G or Combat UX.

## Bounded implementation contracts

### Alerts

- Input is the permitted live message/event projection plus a data-driven category policy. Output is presentation state and an attention intent routed through the existing command façade.
- The coordinator consumes each event identity once. Repeated panel refresh, reopening a panel or replay scrubbing must not issue duplicate pause/1x commands.
- For simultaneous attention requests, proposed deterministic precedence is Pause above DropTo1x; preserve event identity and display all relevant reasons. Dismissing one alert must not clear another unresolved pause reason.
- Routine duplicate grouping may reduce visual noise; it must retain occurrence counts and never suppress a newly actionable approval.
- Live policy changes take effect for subsequent events; historical events do not retrigger implicitly.
- At every supported acceleration, verify where the stop is observed relative to extra pipeline steps. A display-only next-frame notification is not proof that intermediate critical events are actionable.
- Replay/AAR can inspect notifications but cannot mutate the recorded run. Observer commands stay disabled.
- Hold prior DLZ countdown semantics until authoritative remaining-window facts are available; do not derive a firing deadline from animation.

### Control handoff

- Use the existing public direct-control APIs. Preserve the exactly-one-controller invariant.
- Treat agent pause independently from simulation pause and from group detachment. Do not implement “pause agent” by freezing the world or silently seizing the unit.
- First demonstrate the supported suspension/resume seam and task-retention behavior. If absent, record a domain dependency rather than storing authority in a UI widget.
- Repeated take/release and rejected commands must not duplicate queue entries or controller-change records.
- Current badges and initial assignment are delivered dependencies to reuse.

### Doctrine and uncertainty

- Keep the domain resolver as the only policy authority. Expose the source that actually resolved each supported value.
- Do not claim Group inheritance or per-field inheritance merely because the proposed UI enumerates those levels.
- Reset requires a real command and authoritative resulting policy; no mutation of scenario dictionaries from a host.
- Identification confidence, positional uncertainty, track freshness and communications quality remain separate fields.
- Unknown numeric precision or tolerance stays Unknown. Do not translate High/Medium/Low identity confidence into an ellipse.
- Any later ambiguity thresholds must be domain-owned, versioned, and covered by boundary tests. Reference-product multipliers are not proof that Aegis supports them.
- Live last-reported positions depend on [DRG-417](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-417); production targetability evidence depends on [DRG-414](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-414). Mock providers must be labeled as fixtures.

## Candidate files for impact analysis

These are discovered candidate paths, not a CMANO Surface stamp or permission to change protected hubs.

| Lane | Existing anchors | Proposed additions / required investigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alerts | src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MessageLogProjection.cs; src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/MessageLogBridge.cs; src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/C2ClockCommand.cs; unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MessageLogPanelHost.cs | New pure policy/attention projection and tests; inspect supported time-command façade; thin host integration only after impact |
| Handoff | src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Controllers/ControllerSlot.cs; src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/DelegationOrchestrator.cs; unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/RightUnitPanelHost.cs | Read existing take/release APIs and suspension semantics; scope any missing domain command separately |
| Doctrine | src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/DoctrineInheritanceProjection.cs; DoctrineInheritancePanelBinder.cs in the same folder; unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/DoctrineInheritancePanelHost.cs | Extend current contract and tests; verify reset command; ScenarioPolicyProfile.cs is the resolver reference |
| Information quality | src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/ContactProvenance.cs; ContactProvenanceProjection.cs in the same folder | Reuse provenance for badges; discover authoritative uncertainty/tolerance sources before DRG-411 numeric presentation |
| Save | src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Baltic/BalticReplayHarness.cs | ADR-029 proposed Save/ DTO/journal/driver and shared stepper; no bridge/session edits |

## Integrated acceptance scenario

Use a new isolated scenario/fixture identifier; do not alter Baltic v2 fixtures.

| Step | Player observation / action | Required proof |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plan | Assign an agent to a group, inspect doctrine and control ownership | Actual current source labels and controller badges |
| Accelerate | Run at 1x and supported higher rates; introduce a visible critical event | One policy-driven stop request; no hidden-information leak |
| Decide | Inspect blocked engagement and pending approval | Shooter/target/event-time correlation; authoritative reason; countdown only when supported |
| Intervene | Take control, pause/resume agent as supported, issue order, return | Single controller, correct tasking/group semantics, logged outcome |
| Lose link | Degrade then deny communications | Stale/unknown states; queued versus rejected command distinctions; last report only from a live source |
| Recover | Restore communications and review | Updated information with explicit provenance; no claim that DRG-391 reconciliation is already delivered |
| Replay | Revisit the same events and attempt a command | Stable explanation; observer input rejected; no log mutation |

Record build SHA, scenario/catalog/policy identity, seed, input steps, expected/actual outcomes, screenshots and failures. Keep headless tests, proxy tests, Editor evidence and owner acceptance separate. DRG-208's historical Done state is not acceptance of this new package.

## ADR and requirement reconciliation

- REQ-04 contains per-phase lethal-autonomy opt-in language while ADR-023 remains Proposed. Package decision: retain existing runtime behavior, explicitly track the unmet requirement and proposed deferral; do not silently accept ADR-023 or claim opt-in is implemented.
- ADR-021 accepts headless/CI-scoped mission timeline execution. This package uses supported runtime commands and labeled fixtures; interactive mission scripting remains a later architecture amendment.
- ADR-029 accepted Option B governs save/resume: same build/catalog/scenario, three manual slots plus rolling autosave, restored approvals/orders/override, paused load, dropped watch acknowledgements, W0. Older open-decision text in DRG-348 is superseded by those decisions.
- ADR-010 §2–3 / ADR-007 / ADR-001 govern UI boundaries. ADR-018 remains the datalink decision, not the UI boundary.
- No DelegationBridge hotpath or frozen SimulationSession mutation is authorized by this plan. No golden re-bless.

## Subsequent improvement queue

After the first package: multi-target allocation DRG-410; countermeasures DRG-387 and ECCM persistence DRG-416; comms reconnection DRG-391; component damage DRG-394/395; bounded ASW slice DRG-381/382/385; weather DRG-378/380; campaign DRG-399 after save proof. Reuse existing stories.

Design proposals retained for later scoping: objective/decision-quality scoring, attention-management UX built on the existing forecast, and mission-package consequence explanations. No runtime delivery claimed.

## Execution state and remaining gates

- Repository and connected-source review completed at the pinned revision.
- Documentation and existing backlog updates are the deliverables of this pass.
- Desktop Commander reports DRG-Flo-Laptop Offline; no GitNexus endpoint is exposed in this session.
- `AGENTS.md` requires impact analysis before symbol edits. Runtime editing is blocked until the indexed development environment is accessible; no bypass or speculative patch.
- No build, tests, Unity walk, commit, push or merge was performed.
- First resume action: verify checkout/index revision, read current local instructions, run path-specific GitNexus context/impact, approve a bounded file surface under the existing workflow, then implement and run required checks.

## Follow-through recorded

The companion DRG-348 — Same-build save/resume contract draft (2026-10-30) is available. Ten existing Linear issues have been updated with the delivery scope, acceptance refinements and source corrections: DRG-408, DRG-398, DRG-269, DRG-247, DRG-409, DRG-271, DRG-411, DRG-235, DRG-348 and DRG-349. DRG-348 is In Progress for the drafted contract; its exhaustive inventory and review obligations remain open. The other nine issues remain Backlog. No code changes or runtime tests are claimed.

pages.title: DRG-348 — Same-build save/resume contract draft (2026-10-30)
pages.content:
Status: Draft contract for review under [DRG-348](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348). Not an implemented save feature, exhaustive state proof, or owner acceptance.
Date: 
Baseline: [main 570a7f84](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51).
Normative direction: [accepted ADR-029](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/docs/architecture/adr-029-h6-save-resume.md).

## Product decisions already settled

ADR-029 records Option B, accepted by the owner: single-player same-build/same-catalog/same-scenario resume via an external input journal and re-simulation from tick zero. Three manual slots and one rolling autosave; mid-engagement save allowed. Restore orders, pending approvals and direct-control override; present the restored session paused; discard watch acknowledgements and rebuild cards. Revisit the method if representative load time exceeds about 30 seconds. W0: no bridge or frozen-session waiver. Multiplayer is a separate later horizon.

These decisions supersede the older open questions in DRG-348 and the historical spike. They do not prove that every interactive state can already be reconstructed.

## State ownership and reconstruction inventory

Each row is a required coverage category. Current-source reads verified selected owners; full transitive mutable-field enumeration and interactive parity remain DRG-349 evidence obligations.

| State | Owner / source | Persistence strategy | Verification obligation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Build, scenario, policies, catalog, seed | ScenarioPolicyProfile; catalog binding; scenario setup | Pin exact identities, complete content hashes, canonical initialization manifest and seed | Reject any mismatch before touching active state |
| Observed time and pipeline time | ISimWorldSnapshot; SimulationSession; SimClock | Store both boundary coordinates; reproduce advancement with shared stepper | Check acceleration >1 and zero-time/paused command ordering |
| Phase and simulation mode | DelegationOrchestrator; DelegationBridge.ConfigureSimulationMode | Initial manifest plus ordered public commands | Planning→execution and supported mode transitions reproduced |
| Controller slots, detached members, assignments | DelegationOrchestrator; ControllerSlot; DetachRejoinService | Replay initial assignment and take/release/assign commands | Same active/suspended controller and group membership |
| Agent traits, scheduling and attention | AgentController; DecisionPipeline; TryRebindAgentTraits; TryRebriefAgent | Reconstruct from identical setup, tick/input ordering and journaled changes | Same future decisions after restoration, not only same current hash |
| Delegation RNG | Decision/SeededRng private \_state | Reproduce draw sequence from seed; no reflection or hydration | Future multi-tick differential equality |
| Simulation RNG | Sim/Core/SeededRng | Reproduce deterministic seed/domain/entity/tick/draw inputs | Same outcomes in differential runs |
| Pending approvals | PendingApprovalQueue; TryApprovePendingOrder / TryRejectPendingOrder | Journal approval/rejection and re-create queue through execution | Save immediately before/after approval; omission is rejected |
| Human queues and comms delay | HumanController; PlayerOrderExecutionQueue; bridge enqueue APIs | Journal original command arguments and timing; replay through public calls | Delayed-order sequence/content and actual execution boundary agree |
| Attack choice and one-shot salvo | TryEnqueueAttackOption; SimulationSession.NextEngageSalvoOverride | Preserve complete selected option and salvo arguments | Save between enqueue and consumption; salvo executes exactly once |
| Mission timeline and trigger cursors | MissionRuntime / MissionContactTriggerRuntime in harness composition | Reconstruct with identical setup and shared stepper | Do not imply interactive mission support beyond ADR-021 |
| Sensor/contact/custody and spoof state | Sensor simulators; bridge/harness timelines | Reconstruct from scenario, catalog, inputs and ordered ticks | Fresh/stale/lost transitions and future behavior agree |
| Comms-grid and reported state | DelegationOrchestrator.CommsGrid; CommsGridRegistry; bridge comms timeline | Include configured transitions and any supported external mutations in manifest/journal | Off-grid command behavior agrees; DRG-417's unimplemented live feed is not a save capability |
| Engagements, magazines, kills, BDA and damage | SimulationSession resource/lifecycle owners | Reconstruct complete world and order-sink side effects | In-flight/queued actions, ammunition and post-resume results agree |
| Fuel, air/boat readiness and withdraw state | FuelTimelineTracker; AirOpsStateMap; BoatOpsStateMap; readiness/withdraw owners | Reconstruct from authoritative cadence and configuration | Compare future fuel bands, readiness and withdrawal decisions |
| Watch reasons, cards and time control | WatchAttentionQueue; WatchAutoPauseGate; clock façade | Reproduce time-affecting command/event sequence during reconstruction; drop acknowledgements in final product projection | Dropped acknowledgement must not change historical re-simulation; restored session remains paused |
| Order log and checkpoints | DecisionLog; ReplayCheckpointStore | Regenerate log, compare evidence; checkpoints are verification only | Exact row order/content, fingerprint and world checkpoints |
| Optional provider/advisor state | Hindsight or other configured integrations | No fresh external calls during restore; replay recorded inputs/results if authority-affecting | Provider inventory required; unsupported run configurations fail explicitly |
| Camera, selection, panels | Presentation hosts | Non-authoritative; optional preferences separate from save truth | No influence on simulation fingerprint |

Current source confirms [ReplayCheckpointStore](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Replay/ReplayCheckpointStore.cs) stores hashes/ticks/sequence metadata only; [PlayerOrderRecord](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Decision/PlayerOrderRecord.cs) does not preserve complete command/risk/salvo payloads; [CatalogSnapshotHasher](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Data/Snapshots/CatalogSnapshotHasher.cs) hashes sensor rows only. None is sufficient as a complete save payload.

## Proposed envelope

Field names below are proposed schema, not existing API names.

| Group | Required contents |
| --- | --- |
| Format | saveSchemaVersion, producerBuildId, journalSchemaVersion |
| Identity | scenarioId and hash; policy identities/hashes; catalog snapshot ID plus complete catalog digest; initialization-manifest digest; seed |
| Boundary | observedSimTime, observedTick, pipelineTick, phase, lastInputOrdinal, lastOrderSequence |
| Inputs | Ordered versioned typed command rows with complete payloads, exact execution boundary and monotonic ordinal |
| Verification | Journal digest; envelope digest; expected world hash; order-log fingerprint; checkpoint records |
| Presentation metadata | Slot identity, user label, creation time and display summary; never authoritative ordering inputs |

Use canonical encoding with invariant numeric representation and stable ordering. Specify digest coverage explicitly, excluding the digest field itself. A digest checks integrity; it does not authenticate an untrusted save. Unknown schema/command versions are rejected rather than silently skipped. Complete catalog identity must cover every input consumed by the run, not merely sensor rows.

## Input journal contract

1. Enumerate every supported externally invocable state-changing path. Initial binding/configuration belongs in the pinned setup manifest or a journal row.
2. Include BeginExecution, supported mode changes, assignment/rebrief/trait changes, take/release control, human orders, player command IDs, attack option and risk/salvo parameters, approve/reject, pause, guarded resume/explicit override, acceleration, and any authority-affecting watch action.
3. Commands sharing the same observed tick retain a strictly ordered input ordinal and their boundary relative to pipeline advancement. Both clocks are needed under acceleration.
4. Capture call intent before forwarding, and record its result. Do not produce a valid save while any call is incomplete or journal coverage cannot be established. Domain rejection is an observed result, not an excuse to omit a call that could partially mutate state.
5. The restore driver replays each original entry through the same public command boundary and checks results. It must not append duplicate input rows to the journal being replayed.
6. Regenerate DecisionLog from execution. Never load DecisionLog and then reapply its outcome rows as commands.
7. Any new command introduced by the UX package must have a journal coverage entry before that command is advertised as save-compatible.
8. Restore must not repeat external network/provider side effects. If deterministic reproduction requires unrecorded external information, reject that save configuration.

## Capture and atomic storage

Proposed contract detail: capture at a defined quiescent boundary between simulation/command operations, including mid-engagement boundaries. Pin the input journal tail and both clocks from the same boundary. No half-applied command or mixed-time snapshot.

Write a candidate file, complete integrity checks and atomic replacement before reporting success. A failed write preserves the previous manual slot/autosave. The rolling autosave uses the same transaction rules. Autosave cadence and retention outside the four accepted slots remain explicit tuning decisions; they are not settled by ADR-029.

## Restore transaction

1. Parse with bounded input sizes and validate schema, identities, integrity and supported command coverage.
2. Construct an isolated candidate: world, its ISimWorldSnapshot, its IOrderSink, and a fresh DelegationBridge with replay-viewer mode false.
3. Reconstruct setup and all tick/command ordering using a shared stepper. Do not fork a second RunCore implementation.
4. Check recorded command results, journal digest, world hashes, order-log sequence/content/fingerprint and intermediate checkpoints.
5. Compare at the saved logical boundary before applying the product's paused-on-load presentation policy.
6. Swap world, snapshot, sink and bridge together only after successful verification; then expose the paused restored session and rebuild watch cards.
7. On parse, mismatch, replay, cancellation or construction failure, discard the candidate. Preserve the active world, references, queues, RNG evolution and log.

Cancellation and write-failure details are proposed contract refinements. No latency success or atomic-swap implementation is claimed.

## Differential acceptance matrix for DRG-349

| Case | Required result |
| --- | --- |
| Continuous N+M versus save N / restore / M | Same world, log sequence/content and replay fingerprint at restoration and multiple future boundaries |
| At least three interruption points | Before approval, with delayed order, and during engagement/resource change |
| Acceleration 1 and supported >1 | Both clock coordinates and future effects agree |
| Trait/rebrief change immediately before save | Exact behavior retained; omitted row rejected |
| Approve/reject immediately before save | Pending queue and future action agree; missing row cannot pass on world hash alone |
| Take-control and return | Controller/task/group state preserved; no duplicate orders |
| Salvo override pending consumption | Consumed exactly once with the recorded quantity |
| Same-tick multiple inputs | Stable ordinal ordering; swapping rows is rejected or produces a verified mismatch |
| Corrupt/truncated/wrong build/catalog/scenario | Explicit rejection; active session unchanged |
| Incomplete journal or unknown command schema | Save/load rejected; no silent omission |
| Failed file write / canceled restore | Previous slot and live session survive |
| Long-run representative workloads | Measured restore time; investigate loads over the owner's approximate 30-second trigger |

Required repository checks remain build, current full-suite floor, replay/proxy suites, byte-identical v2/v3 golden outputs and preserved v2 hash 17144800277401907079. No test results were generated in this pass.

## Remaining review obligations

- Enumerate all mutable state owners and actual command ingress paths at the implementation revision; the category inventory above is not a claimed exhaustive symbol audit.
- Verify that interactive host world/snapshot/sink behavior can use the shared stepper without touching frozen hubs.
- Specify exact serialization schema, parser bounds, catalog manifest coverage and autosave cadence.
- Inspect optional provider paths for deterministic input capture.
- Amend stale GDD wording about checkpoint hydration and RNG counters in a repository documentation change.
- Obtain fresh GitNexus impact for the shared-stepper and façade call sites before edits.
- Complete DRG-349 proof before treating this contract as delivered save/resume.

## Source references

- [ADR-029](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/docs/architecture/adr-029-h6-save-resume.md)
- [Read-only spike](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/production/agentic/h6-save-model-spike-2026-09-27.md)
- [Spike review](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/production/agentic/h6-save-model-review-2026-10-01.md)
- [SimulationSession](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/SimulationSession.cs)
- [DelegationOrchestrator](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/DelegationOrchestrator.cs)
- [DelegationBridge](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/blob/570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51/src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/DelegationBridge.cs)

Execution limitation: development laptop offline; no GitNexus endpoint available. Documentation review only. Runtime feasibility, performance and owner acceptance remain unverified.

pages.title: .NET 11 upgrade and AI feature integration — delivery plan and parallel dispatch (2026-11-12)
pages.content:
> Execution update 2026-11-14 (coordinator): DRG-724 Done (`latestFeature`; floor = DRG-725 measured). Worktrees: `net11-baseline` (DRG-725), `net11-pr1` (DRG-734 — build 0/0, full suite 4361 pass on net10.0 under SDK 11.0.100), `net11-compat` (DRG-726), `net11-pr2` (DRG-737 retarget in flight). Epic incomplete until DoD hard gates YES after PR 3.

> Ops 2026-11-14: Bossman nodes UP — G-C4 live required (no waiver). Grok Bot client = latest stable for all specialist delegations. Rubric: DoD rubric: cmano-clone .NET 11 upgrade (DRG-722).

> Decision DoD rubric (2026-11-14): DoD rubric: cmano-clone .NET 11 upgrade (DRG-722) · Linear: [https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/document/dod-rubric-net-11-upgrade-decision-2026-11-14-46b9d0d6f9b1](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/document/dod-rubric-net-11-upgrade-decision-2026-11-14-46b9d0d6f9b1)

Status: In execution (2026-11-14). DRG-724 Decision recorded (`latestFeature`; floor = DRG-725 measured). Parallel worktrees: `net11-baseline` (DRG-725), `net11-pr1` (DRG-734 SDK pins), `net11-compat` (DRG-726). SDK 11.0.100 installed on coordinator. Epic still incomplete until DoD hard gates YES after PR 3. This is not product acceptance or a waiver of any frozen runtime boundary.
Review date: 
Source baseline: [main 2ddbd393](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/2ddbd3930bd971aa9648cf6f874f7c810c167142).
Delivery system: Linear, project [cmano-clone](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/project/cmano-clone-7f6a00e4c1c9). All 28 issues are in Backlog. Nothing was added to the Grok Bot workbench Tasks board, so no agent has been dispatched.

## Outcome and scope

Two linked pieces of work.

1. Move the headless build from SDK 10.0.403 and net10.0 to SDK 11.0.100 and net11.0, as a three-PR stack. Epic [DRG-722](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-722).
2. Add model-backed assistance outside simulation ticks: an evidence-linked after-action assistant, structured mission authoring on the proposal lane, and a measured retrieval pilot. Epic [DRG-723](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-723).

File source of truth is Git. The two plan documents are revision 2 of:

- `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-12-dotnet-11-upgrade.md`
- `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-12-dotnet-11-ai-feature-integration.md`


Neither plan document is on origin/main yet. The first drafts exist only in a Windows working tree; revision 2 was delivered as files in the planning conversation. Commit both before promoting any issue to Todo.


## Owner to-do before dispatch

- [ ] Commit revision 2 of both plan documents and the dashboard snapshot they link to
- [ ] Decide `rollForward` and the test-floor raise — [DRG-724](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-724)
- [ ] Decide ADR-015 (labelling of agent-authored content) — [DRG-727](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-727)
- [ ] Choose provider, data terms and cost ceiling — [DRG-728](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-728)
- [ ] Set the retrieval-pilot margin before the pilot runs — [DRG-729](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-729)
- [ ] Accept or waive ADR-030 once drafted — part of [DRG-733](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-733)
- [ ] CMANO: stamp Surface on each issue before it moves to Todo
- [ ] Reindex GitNexus on the implementation revision (the planning index was 218 commits stale)

## Findings that changed the plans

1. The upgrade is not done on main. All 16 projects target net10.0. `global.json` pins 10.0.403 with `rollForward: latestMajor`, so any machine with SDK 11 installed has been building main with it since 2026-11-10. GitHub CI may already be on SDK 11 while Buildkite and ReSharper are not. Not confirmed from CI logs.
2. Runtime Async is opt-in at GA, not preview. The runtime libraries already use it, so library async behaviour changes on net11.0 regardless of opt-in.
3. `AiAuthoringServices`, `scenario_ai_scaffold`, `ProvenanceTag` and `SkillLane.Propose` already exist. Authoring extends those seams. `AiAuthoringServices` lives in `ProjectAegis.Data` (netstandard2.1), so no provider code goes there.
4. The mission-editor CLI is already the MCP tool surface: `tools/mission-editor/mcp-tools.json` holds 52 tools and `McpToolsManifestTests` pins them. Every new verb needs a manifest entry.
5. `tools/copy-delegation-assemblies.sh` copies every DLL from the UnityAdapter netstandard2.1 publish into Unity. An AI package on a shared project would ship into the plug-in folder. AI code therefore lives in separate assemblies, guarded by a test.
6. `NoDynamicExecutionGateTests` matches `Process.Start` only. The .NET 11 `Process.Run*` helpers would pass the scan while breaking its intent. Process helpers are rejected for validation and the gate gets new patterns.
7. .NET 11 behaviour changes that touch this repository: correctly rounded `Math.Round(value, digits)` (used in `ValidationRules.cs` and `PlatformRelativeScaler.cs`, not in tick paths); ZIP CRC32 validation and eager async open (`AegisScenarioPackage`); saturating float-to-small-integer casts (none found); x86-64-v2 minimum CPU.
8. `ImportQaSlice.csproj` is not in `ProjectAegis.sln`, so the solution gates never build it.
9. ADR-015 is still Proposed and past its 2026-09-01 target date. It blocks mission authoring only.

## Dispatch map

Dependency flow:

```javascript
DRG-725 baseline ─┐
DRG-726 fixtures ─┼─> DRG-737 PR 2 retarget (G0) ─┬─> DRG-738 ReSharper
DRG-724 decision ─> DRG-734 PR 1 SDK pins ─┘      ├─> DRG-742 docs
                                                  └─> DRG-743 JSONL writer
DRG-730 contracts ─┐
DRG-731 host ──────┼─> DRG-735 W0 integration ─┬─> DRG-739 AAR pipeline ─┬─> DRG-744 CLI verb
DRG-732 fixtures ──┤                           │                         ├─> DRG-745 live eval
DRG-733 gates/ADR ─┘                           │                         └─> DRG-746 Hindsight
DRG-730 + DRG-732 ─> DRG-736 evidence projection ┘
DRG-735 + DRG-727 ─> DRG-740 authoring ─> DRG-747 CLI mode
DRG-735 + DRG-729 ─> DRG-741 retrieval pilot ─> DRG-748 PDA integration
DRG-744 + DRG-747 ─> DRG-749 optional UI and reports
```

### Startable now (six tracks, disjoint files)

These need no owner decision and no upgrade. They touch only new files or nothing at all. The dispatch playbook caps cloud agents at five and effective tracks at four to six.

| Issue | Track | Proposed owner | Allowed surface |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [DRG-725](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-725) | Upgrade A: baseline capture | team-qa | No repository edits |

## Parallel-development rules

- New directories only for track work. A track never edits a file another track owns.
- Coordinator-owned shared files: `ProjectAegis.sln`, `global.json`, `renovate.json`, every `*.csproj` retarget, `src/ProjectAegis.MissionEditor.Cli/Program.cs`, `tools/mission-editor/mcp-tools.json`, `AGENTS.md`. Issues that edit these carry the `single-owner` label: DRG-734, 735, 737, 744, 747, 748.
- Do not co-schedule DRG-744 with DRG-747 (both edit `Program.cs` and the manifest), or DRG-734 with DRG-735 (both edit `renovate.json`).
- Contracts freeze at the end of Wave 0. Later changes are additive with a schema-version bump.
- One existing shared-project edit in the whole AI epic: the additive finalize method in DRG-746. Everything else in `ProjectAegis.Delegation`, `.Sim`, `.Data` and `.UnityAdapter` is read-only.
- Held issues carry `hold:owner-go` and must not be claimed: DRG-724, 727, 728, 729, 740, 745, 747, 749.
- Graphite: one stack per track. The upgrade is a single three-PR stack.
- Unity work (DRG-749 only) uses the Unity-MCP stack under ADR-027, headless harness first.

## Fences that apply to every issue

- C# `LangVersion` 12.0. No C# 15 unions or closed hierarchies.
- No edits to `DelegationBridge`. `CatalogWriteGate` is extend-only.
- Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged. No ReplayGolden re-bless. v3 goldens untouched.
- No AI call in any tick path. Replay fingerprints match with AI enabled, disabled, delayed or failing.
- No AI package or DLL in the four netstandard2.1 projects or `Assets/Plugins/ProjectAegis`.
- No `*.[db3-redacted]`. Nothing derived from Track A of the dual-track firewall is sent to a provider.
- Evidence text (scenario names, briefs, unit names, retrieved documents) is untrusted data in every slice.
- Evidence is filtered to the viewing side before prompt construction.
- CI needs no credentials. Live evaluations never gate CI.
- Run GitNexus impact before any symbol edit and `detect_changes` before each commit.

## Gates

| Gate | Condition | Unblocks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G0 | DRG-737 merged: full gate script green on net11.0, goldens and plug-in DLL list identical to baseline | DRG-743, DRG-738 baseline update, DRG-742 |
| Wave 0 exit | Contracts frozen, fake client green in CI, fixtures reviewed, ADR-030 accepted or waived | Slices 1 to 4 |
| Slice 2 go/no-go | 100% citation resolution and zero numeric contradictions on two consecutive live runs; owner accepts cost per report | Default-visible AAR assistant |
| Slice 4 gate | Embedding pilot beats keyword baseline by the pre-set margin | DRG-748; otherwise cancel it |

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
| --- | --- |
| Upgrade slips and AI work stalls | Wave 0 and the evidence projection need no net11.0 API |
| AI package leaks into Unity plug-ins | Separate assemblies; architecture test in DRG-733 |
| Fabricated IDs or numbers shown to the player | Host copies numbers; cited IDs validated; reject on mismatch |
| Opposing-force information in player advice | Side filter before prompt build; two-sided fixture |
| Proprietary-derived data sent to a provider | Source allowlist and refusal test |
| Nondeterminism reaches replay | No AI in tick paths; fingerprint tests in four modes |
| Merge conflicts across about 170 remote branches | New directories; coordinator owns shared files |
| Replay hash moves during the upgrade and the cause is unclear | Three-PR stack separates compiler from runtime; PR 2 reverts alone |

## Not verified in this pass

- NuGet versions for [Microsoft.Extensions.AI](http://Microsoft.Extensions.AI) and the evaluation packages (the first draft reported stable 11.0.0).
- ReSharper CLI 2026.3.0 availability and the Renovate rule syntax (taken from the first draft).
- Which SDK recent CI runs actually used.
- GitNexus impact counts (index was stale).
- Hindsight dev-memory decisions (sidecar was unreachable during drafting).

## Execution state

- Repository review completed at the pinned revision from a read-only clone.
- Two epics and 26 sub-issues created in Linear with parent links and blocking relations, all in Backlog.
- Proposed surfaces in each issue are suggestions, not CMANO stamps.
- No build, test, Unity walk, commit, push or merge was performed.
- First resume action: commit the plan documents, record the DRG-724 decision, then have CMANO stamp Surface on the six startable issues.

## Hard gates — epic complete (G0 + PR 3)

### Build

pages.content:
## Status

Parked idea. Needs an ADR before any work. This is a backlog item only, not a commitment.

- Linear: [DRG-779](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-779/explore-in-game-decision-llms-for-player-agent-and-entity-decision)
- Source: drg, Nov 20, 2026

## Scope

Evaluate using decision LLMs (e.g. a Jev-style decision model, Google Decision One, or other LLMs) inside the game runtime.

- Player-facing: advisor and recommendation aids
- Agents: AI-controlled sides and units, doctrine/ROE choices, mission planning
- Other entities: neutral or civilian actors and scenario events

## Out of scope for now

- No implementation
- No change to the deterministic sim hot path (DelegationBridge Tick, CatalogWriteGate, SimulationSession)
- No change to the dev bots' own Decision routing

## Open questions

- Determinism and replay (ReplayGolden)
- Latency and cost
- Offline/local vs hosted models
- Which decisions are LLM-eligible
- Safety and guardrails
- Evaluation against current AI

## Related

This is broader than the earlier Jev-only player-assist research, which is already complete: Jev AI — in-game decisioning research (2026-09-22) and Linear [DRG-318](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-318/research-jev-ai-in-game-decisioning-choice-score-noul-req-draft) (Done, 2026-09-22).
